title: FamilyAlbum - Photo Sharing
summary: Family memories made private. Relive, organize & share pictures & videos easily.
description:
FamilyAlbum: The easiest way to privately & safely share photos and videos with your family.

SOUND LIKE YOU?

• Chaotic group chats, everything gets lost
• Posting on social media feels weird or too exposed
• Camera roll = 10,000+ photos, 0 organization
• Can’t find the one photo when you actually need it
• “I’ll send it later” (you forget)
• Scrolling forever in messages just to find one pic

You know why that happens? Because most photo sharing apps aren’t actually built for families in the first place!

The result?: Your most important memories get lost, and even worse, forgotten.

THE SOLUTION

FamilyAlbum is a private photo sharing app built for families who want a safe, simple way to store, organize, and relive their most special moments.

Create a shared space where your entire family can stay connected without the intrusiveness of social media.

From everyday updates to once-in-a-lifetime milestones, your memories live here — beautifully organized, backed up, and always accessible.

SEND & SHARE WITH YOUR FAMILY

• Easily send photos and videos to your entire family in seconds
• Create shared albums everyone can access
• Keep loved ones updated on life’s most special moments
• Designed for easy sharing, no matter where you are
• Free to use, with optional upgrades

SAFE, PRIVATE, & SECURE

• Your photos and videos stay safe and private
• Only invited members can view and interact
• A trusted space for your most important family memories
• Built as a secure backup for your photos and videos

CAPTURE BABY & FAMILY GROWTH

• Perfect for creating a baby album from day one
• Watch your family grow through photos and videos
• Preserve every milestone, big or small
• Turn everyday updates into lasting memory collections

Your family photos & videos shouldn’t just be something you look at once in a text. They’re something you should experience and relive.

With FamilyAlbum, you can see your family’s journey evolve over time, one moment at a time.

ORGANIZE YOUR MEMORIES EASILY

• Automatically organize your photos and videos
• Use it as your go-to memory organizer
• Never lose track of important moments again
• Build a living family book of your life together

From birthdays to holidays, everything is organized so finding photos and videos is as easy as possible!

BACKUP & STORE ALL YOUR CONTENT

• Unlimited storage for your photos and videos
• Reliable backup so nothing gets lost
• Access your memories anytime, anywhere
• Never worry about losing your family memories again

FREE PHOTO PRINTS EVERY MONTH

• Enjoy free photo prints delivered to your door every month
• Turn your digital memories into physical keepsakes
• Easily select and print photos straight from your album
• Create a tangible family book you can hold and share

Your special moments deserve more than just living on your phone. From your coffee table to your fridge to your walls – FamilyAlbum brings them to life!

BUILT FOR EVERY FAMILY

Perfect for:

• Expecting moms and dads creating baby albums
• Grandparents who want to stay connected
• Families looking for a safe & private place to share and store memories
• Backing up your most important photos and videos
• Watching your family album grow over time
• Reliving moments through nostalgia

A HOME FOR YOUR FAMILY’S STORY

FamilyAlbum is where your family’s story lives.

• A private space to send, store, and relive memories
• A memory organizer & storage designed for real life
• A growing family album captured through everyday moments
• A place where your special moments never get lost

No social media. No intrusion. Just your family, your memories, and a space to keep them safe.

Create your first album today and relive your precious memories forever!

FamilyAlbum Website - https://family-album.com

For migrating to FamilyAlbum from services like Lifecake and BackThen, visit help.family-album.com.

If you have any questions, please don’t hesitate to contact us at support@family-album.com.
